actions.new_feature: Clear criteria: resets every parameter of the report to its default value.
Run: preview on screen, then print or export in the chosen output format.
Add to favorites: saves the report with the current criteria as a favorite (saved view).

controls.notes: PRINT / PREVIEW always previews on screen first. Enhanced with csv. Excel is a flat typed sheet, not the legacy merged layout.
Office versus Office Group. The Office Group option is greyed on Routing Slip and the four Ledger reports (mode locked to office); the whole control is greyed on Referral Source List.

108 = id of the office the user was working in. Offices (mode office) or office groups (mode office_group). Vendor documentation: Office = one or more offices the user can access (default the logged-in office); Office Group = groups from Setup > Office Groups (default ALL). Greyed (locked to the working office) on the four Ledger reports and display-only on Referral Source List. The selection becomes exactly one of the value keys office_ids / office_group_id / office_group_ids; tokens working_office, my_offices; all = every office (or group) the caller may read.

Legacy SELECT dialog (dual list with INCLUDE ALL, search, sort) becomes a searchable multi-select; ALL = no restriction. Dialog content was never captured - confirm list source and inactive rows on the live tool. Provider role (line, appointment, preferred) is declared per report. Greyed on the two Aging reports until GROUP BY PROVIDER is ticked.
Lookup-fed dropdown captured collapsed (ALL plus tenant rows). Legacy is single-select; the parameter accepts a list (enhancement). Confirm list source on the live tool.
Lookup-fed dropdown captured collapsed (ALL plus tenant rows). Legacy is single-select; the parameter accepts a list (enhancement). Confirm list source on the live tool. Static list of states.

dynamic_rules.legacy_effect: The SELECT picker chooses office groups defined in Setup > Office Groups (for example regions) instead of offices; when no office groups are defined, a group run covers all offices of the account. Cross-cutting statement of the document for all Lists screens (vendor articles on office groups and on the new reports menu) - recorded once here; it applies to all four Provider List reports.

legacy_corrections.text: The number in the office box is not a fixed default: with the Office radio the box defaults to the current office (the OID of the session, the same number the title bar shows) and SELECT picks other offices. Recorded once here; it applies to the office box of all four Provider List reports.

Primary date range. Legacy title LAST VISIT DATE RANGE is a mislabel on Provider Holidays: the range is the holiday date (date_basis = holiday_date). Default = today in the office time zone (relative token). Enhanced with presets and relative tokens.
Primary date range, inclusive end; date_basis = holiday_date (legacy title is a mislabel). Default = today in the office time zone (relative token). Enhanced with presets and relative tokens.

legacy_corrections.text: The section header LAST VISIT DATE RANGE is not a misreading: it is a re-used string. The vendor's screenshots show that header on Patient List - Grouped By in Last Visit mode. On Provider Holidays the two dates are read as the holiday date range - that reading is the document's, since no vendor description of this report exists.
